{"findings": [{"severity": "HIGH", "title": "Argo CD 'platform' project is fully permissive (wildcard destinations, sources, all cluster resources)", "resource": "AppProject/platform (argocd)", "controls": [], "evidence": "The digest shows project 'platform' with wildcard_destination, wildcard_sources and all_cluster_resources all true, and app 'alloy' uses it.", "fix": "kubectl -n argocd patch appproject platform --type merge -p '{"spec":{"destinations":[{"server":"https://kubernetes.default.svc","namespace":"<ns>"}],"sourceRepos":["<repo-url>"],"clusterResourceWhitelist":[{"group":"","kind":"Namespace"}]}}'", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "HIGH", "title": "Argo CD manager ServiceAccount bound to cluster-admin", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/argocd-manager (SA kube-system/argocd-manager)", "controls": [], "evidence": "Binding 'argocd-manager' grants role cluster-admin to ServiceAccount kube-system/argocd-manager; combined with the permissive 'platform' project this gives broad cluster takeover paths.", "fix": "Replace with a scoped ClusterRole: kubectl delete clusterrolebinding argocd-manager, then bind a role limited to the resources Argo CD needs.", "confidence": "medium"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Argo CD apps track mutable revisions in risky projects", "resource": "Application/root (project default), Application/alloy (project platform)", "controls": [], "evidence": "App 'root' targets revision HEAD in project 'default' and 'alloy' targets branch 'main'.", "fix": "spec.source.targetRevision: <tag-or-commit-SHA>; move 'root' into a restricted AppProject.", "confidence": "medium"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Pods missing seccomp profile", "resource": "2 workloads (not named in digest)", "controls": ["Trivy PSS 10 (Seccomp)"], "evidence": "Trivy PSS control 10 Seccomp failed on 2 resources; 16 of 17 PSS controls passed.", "fix": "securityContext:
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Unfixed MEDIUM image vulnerabilities", "resource": "cluster images (not named in digest)", "controls": [], "evidence": "Trivy k8s reports 8 MEDIUM vulnerabilities and no CRITICAL/HIGH ones.", "fix": "Run trivy k8s for the affected images and upgrade to the fixed versions.", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "Containers lack immutable root filesystem", "resource": "4 resources, e.g. argocd/Deployment/argocd-server", "controls": ["C-0017"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0017 failed on 4 resources; Trivy also reports 4 LOW misconfigurations, not itemized.", "fix": "securityContext:
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true", "confidence": "high"}, {"severity": "LOW", "title": "cluster-admin bound to system:masters group", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin", "controls": [], "evidence": "Binding 'cluster-admin' grants cluster-admin to Group system:masters, which looks like a Kubernetes platform default.", "fix": "No change needed; restrict membership of system:masters credentials.", "confidence": "medium"}], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 14, "failed": 6, "skipped": 6, "score": 75}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 12, "failed": 4, "skipped": 6, "score": 80}, {"name": "Trivy PSS", "passed": 16, "failed": 1, "skipped": 0, "score": null}], "not_checked": [{"item": "node and control-plane CIS checks", "reason": "need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"}, {"item": "git history", "reason": "secrets removed from history are not scanned"}, {"item": "Kubescape failed controls beyond C-0017", "reason": "NSA shows 6 failed and MITRE 4 failed, but the digest lists only C-0017"}, {"item": "Skipped Kubescape controls", "reason": "6 skipped in each framework with no detail in the digest"}, {"item": "Repositories", "reason": "no repos in the digest"}], "summary": "The mgmt cluster has no CRITICAL/HIGH image CVEs, secrets or itemized misconfigurations in the digest. The main risks are in Argo CD: the 'platform' project allows any destination, source and cluster resource, and the argocd-manager ServiceAccount holds cluster-admin. Other issues are a missing seccomp profile on 2 workloads, 8 MEDIUM CVEs and a few LOW hardening gaps. Node and control-plane checks were not run.", "targets": ["mgmt"]}
